gloss: end of an act; finale; conclusion

definitions.gloss: end of an act; final scene; curtain fall
definitions.explanation: The closing scene or final moments of an act in a play or theatrical performance.
The concluding phase or final moments of an event, situation, or era. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: {幕切|まくぎ}れが{見事|みごと}だった。
{芝居|しばい}の{幕切|まくぎ}れで{観客|かんきゃく}は{涙|なみだ}を{流|なが}した。
examples.english: The audience shed tears at the final scene of the play.

examples.japanese: この{舞台|ぶたい}は{幕切|まくぎ}れの{演出|えんしゅつ}が{素晴|すば}らしく、{余韻|よいん}が{長|なが}く{残|のこ}る。
examples.english: The staging of the final scene in this performance is wonderful, leaving a lingering impression.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{交渉|こうしょう}の{幕切|まくぎ}れだった。
examples.english: It was the end of long negotiations.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけない{幕切|まくぎ}れとなった。
examples.english: It came to an unexpected end.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{幕切|まくぎ}れは{誰|だれ}もが{予想|よそう}しなかった{形|かたち}で{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: The end of the war came in a way no one had expected.

notes:
FORMATION: {幕|まく} (curtain, act) + {切|き}れ (cutting, end). Originally a theater term referring to the moment when the curtain falls at the end of an act.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幕切|まくぎ}れを{迎|むか}える: to reach the finale
- {見事|みごと}な{幕切|まくぎ}れ: a splendid ending
- {意外|いがい}な{幕切|まくぎ}れ: an unexpected ending
- {幕切|まくぎ}れの{場面|ばめん}: the closing scene

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幕切|まくぎ}れ: ending, finale (theatrical origin, literary)
- {結末|けつまつ}: conclusion, outcome (neutral, for stories/events)
- フィナーレ: finale (loanword, often for performances)
